macro.text: Fed minutes from the Sept 15-16 meeting showed most officials still expect another rate hike by year-end, but with no appetite for a series of hikes. Traders pared October hike odds to below 22% following the release.
The 10-year Treasury yield backed off a 24-year high after a solid auction eased demand fears, though the 30-year touched its own 24-year high earlier in a broader global yield sell-off.
The dollar rose as Fed minutes reinforced a higher-for-longer rate outlook, pushing sterling to a 16-month low versus the euro and the Indian rupee to record lows.

Oil swung both ways as IEA members agreed to prioritize diesel stock releases even while tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz hit their highest weekly total since the war began. Diesel and heating oil prices keep surging, prompting a White House order and warnings from industry executives against an export ban.
Gold fell after Fed minutes signaled another rate hike is likely by year-end, reducing the metal's near-term appeal.
Iran-linked tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz hit their highest weekly level since the war began, and the Secretary of State said Tehran has missed multiple chances for a nuclear deal.

corporate.note: Constellation Brands beat on earnings and revenue as beer brands gained share, but inventory rebuilding and cautious consumers clouded the demand outlook, prompting marketing pushes to win back beer drinkers.
Alamos Gold outlined a growth plan targeting 1 million ounces of production at an industry conference.
Webull shares dropped 18% after a congressional panel concluded its China ties pose a national security risk, exposing customer data to surveillance concerns.
Google was ordered to halt work on two data centers in Finland, a setback for its AI infrastructure buildout in the region.

SpaceX is weighing raising up to $40 billion in debt, with Apollo and banks in talks to finance the purchase of Nvidia GPUs for its AI buildout, as AI-related bond yields have risen since its June IPO.
Microsoft unveiled a $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing an Nvidia AI chip, signaling continued commitment to its own PC hardware line.
Bullish 'another Micron triple' calls are circulating, though debate continues over whether the memory upcycle is sustainable at current valuations.
Meta's Muse personal AI assistant topped app charts while still free, with the company now needing to convert usage into habitual engagement and a business model.
Fifth Third named Darren King to head its expanded Commercial Bank division.
Disney+ will stream the upcoming Super Bowl along with two Monday Night Football games leading into it, extending its sports-rights push.

frontPage.watch: Q3 earnings season kicks off this week with big banks reporting; watch whether blockbuster profits can justify record index levels. Keep an eye on oil and diesel given escalating Hormuz tanker attacks, and on Treasury yields after the post-auction pullback, since both are driving the dollar and gold.
